ticketCurrency.description: Item id players spend at ticket machines and /card load. Default matches the old hardcoded emerald. An unknown or invalid id falls back to minecraft:emerald.

freeTicketBarriers.description: When true, ticket barriers, ticket processors and ATA fare gates open without charging or checking a station. Entry records and balance are left unchanged.

zoneFareBase.description: ATA zone fare added on top of nothing when freeTicketBarriers is also set. 0 leaves charging to MTR.

zoneFareStep.description: Added once per zone crossed between tap-in and tap-out. 0 with zoneFareBase 0 disables ATA zone fares.

dailyFareCap.description: Most one player is charged by ATA zone fares in a Minecraft day. 0 means no cap.

fareZoneTable.description: Station key to zone, comma separated, for example central=1,airport=3. Keys are trimmed and lower cased. Unknown stations are zone 0. Empty keeps older worlds unchanged.
